title: Map
text: Use previously calculated index and fraction values to accelerate approximation of two-dimensional function, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Interpolation method} sets Select interpolation method Linear; {Targeted Routine Library} Indicates the AUTOSAR routine library used for block code replacement, {Targeted Routine} sets the aUTOSAR library routine used for code replacement, {Data Specification} sets how to enter table data, {Name}, {Table data} defines the table of output values, {Edit table and breakpoints} sets the launch Lookup Table Editor dialog box and {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point or floating-point operations. Values come from the instance.
